purpose: Prepare a separately reported amended FPR analysis for the completed but inconclusive A/S12/R2 unit without changing the frozen U05 result.

proposed_treatment.original_artifacts: Preserve all raw records, analyses, annotations, and hashes unchanged.
proposed_treatment.primary_frozen_result: Keep the original A/R2/S12 abstention and current U05 FPR A withheld status unchanged.
proposed_treatment.amended_analysis: If separately approved, exclude the original A/R2/S12 run only from the explicitly labeled amended sensitivity matrix and include one complete isolated replacement unit. Do not merge candidate sets.
proposed_treatment.replacement_inclusion: Require ten distinct candidates, all required analyses and confirmations complete, and the frozen unit eligibility check to pass.
proposed_treatment.failure_policy: If replacement is incomplete, invalid, or inconclusive, the amended FPR A remains ineligible. No automatic retry or second replacement is authorized.
proposed_treatment.post_result_selection_risk: This is a post-result amendment because the original complete run was inconclusive. Retain and report the frozen primary result alongside the amendment. Obtain researcher and adviser methodological approval before freeze.

metric_outcomes_if_amended_replacement_i.negative: FPR A replicate 2 is 0/3 and the three-replicate A mean is 0%.
metric_outcomes_if_amended_replacement_i.positive: FPR A replicate 2 is 1/3 and the three-replicate A mean is 11.11%.

review_and_assembly.val01_annotation_for_fpr_calculation: not used by the FPR formula
review_and_assembly.full_cohort_revalidation: If the amended cohort is used for the full 990-candidate validation report, create a blinded addendum for the ten replacement candidates and exclude the ten superseded annotations from that amended cohort mapping. Preserve both original and amended annotation files.
review_and_assembly.cohort_rule: Keep the original frozen cohort and amended sensitivity cohort as separate, hash-bound analyses.

required_approvals: explicit researcher approval of the post-result amended-analysis treatment
adviser methodological approval recorded for the amended analysis
